# Sacred Circle

> Sacred Circle is a free, warm community offering healing, manifestation and meditation teaching. All sessions and materials are offered freely, as seva, with no registration or fee.

## Founders

- Lina Bhave — co-founder and meditation teacher. M.Sc. from the Institute of Science, Nagpur. Has taught gentle, practical meditation and healing techniques for 28 years.
- Diwakar Raipure — co-founder and meditation teacher. M.Tech. from IIT Madras, Chennai. Has studied and practised healing and meditation for 28 years and more than 100 modalities.
- Both learned from facilitators and gurus in India and abroad and developed simple, effective techniques that are easy to learn. Their teaching is grounded, unhurried and open to people of every background and age.

## Weekly meditation

- Free Weekly Sunday Meditation Session, every Sunday at 4:00 PM IST, online.
- Open to all, including complete beginners and older adults. No fee, no registration, no prior experience needed.

## Answers to common questions

- Are sessions free? Yes — every session and all materials are free.
- When is the weekly session? Every Sunday at 4:00 PM IST, online.
- Who teaches? Lina Bhave and Diwakar Raipure, founders with 28 years of practice and 100+ modalities.
- How do I join? Join the WhatsApp community or email sacredcircle45@gmail.com.
